acceptOffer(uint256).details: Follows CEI: status is set to Accepted before any external token transfers.      Ask: buyer pays seller directly, market releases escrowed tokens to buyer.      Bid: seller provides tokens to buyer, market releases escrowed payment to seller.

params.offerId: The ID of the offer to accept

cancelOffer(uint256).details: Follows checks-effects-interactions: status is set before any external transfer

params.offerId: The ID of the offer to cancel

claimExpiredOffer(uint256).details: Allows an admin keeper (or any caller) to automatically process expired offers      before burnAll fires, so creators recover their tokens without being online.      Sets status to Expired (distinct from Cancelled) and emits OfferExpired.      Follows CEI: status is updated before any external transfer.

params.offerId: The ID of the expired offer to process

params._paymentToken: Address of the MockUSDC payment token contract

returns._0: offerId The ID of the newly created offer
offerId The ID of the newly created offer

params.offerId: The ID of the offer to retrieve

MAX_PRICE().notice: Maximum price per swipe in MockUSDC (6 decimals) — $12.00

acceptOffer(uint256).notice: Accepts a pending offer and executes the swap atomically

cancelOffer(uint256).notice: Cancels a pending offer and returns escrowed assets to the creator

claimExpiredOffer(uint256).notice: Returns escrowed assets to the creator of an expired offer. Callable by anyone.

createBuyOffer(uint256,uint256).notice: Posts a bid to buy meal swipes, transferring payment into escrow immediately

createSellOffer(uint256,uint256).notice: Lists meal swipes for sale, transferring them into escrow immediately

getOffer(uint256).notice: Returns the full Offer struct for a given offerId

offerCount().notice: Auto-incrementing counter used to generate offer IDs

owner().notice: Deployer address. Admin for emergency functions.
